controls.source_trace: Route/resolver -> identity -> record lookup -> policy -> serialization.
controls.controlled_verification: Compare one private disposable record with its owner and another controlled account; inspect fields and owner-side state.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Private policy must be established; opaque IDs/public records do not prove a failure.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Enforce policy before read/write; denied action exposes no protected fields and leaves state unchanged.

controls.source_trace: Tenant context -> query filter -> count/group/pagination -> export.
controls.controlled_verification: Compare two synthetic tenants in list, count and export outputs.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: An empty list does not establish isolated counts or exports.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Apply tenant policy before aggregation/pagination; test both tenants and a legitimate export.

controls.source_trace: Setup/invitation/role change -> caller authority -> persisted capability.
controls.controlled_verification: Use a controlled low-role account and an inert disposable invitation/role fixture.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Hidden navigation is not enforcement; an already-admin caller is not privilege escalation.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Central policy guards every lifecycle entry point; verify resulting roles directly.

controls.source_trace: Policy decision -> cache lookup/key -> response reuse across actors.
controls.controlled_verification: Warm a synthetic owner response, then request it from a different controlled identity.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Equal bodies for intentionally public content are expected.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Bind cached representation to relevant identity/tenant/policy context; verify cold and warm paths.

controls.source_trace: Subscription creation/batch loader/worker -> current identity -> object set.
controls.controlled_verification: Test one controlled subscription or batch with mixed permitted/forbidden fixture objects.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Connection authentication alone does not establish per-object authorization.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Each object/action is authorized at the appropriate lifecycle point; denied elements do not leak.

controls.source_trace: URL parse -> normalization -> DNS resolution -> redirect hops -> egress.
controls.controlled_verification: Use approved and disallowed owned callback fixtures; inspect every attempted destination.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A caller-supplied public URL alone is not SSRF; keep internal endpoints out of the probe.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Reject disallowed destinations before connection, including later redirects/resolutions.
